items.title: That Guy Can Do Anything
items.content_html: “That guy can do anything!” sounds nice, right? What if it didn’t matter… what if you draw corporate cat-calls for your sexy skills, excel every year, receieve accolades but you were told to change everything for no reason or else be fired…
